BREAKING: Malaysia is preparing to trial Starlink Direct-to-Cell. 🇲🇾🛰️

•⁠  ⁠Compatible smartphones will be able to connect directly to Starlink satellites beyond the reach of mobile towers.
•⁠  ⁠Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil confirmed the government has been briefed on plans for a pilot trial.
•⁠  ⁠Malaysia's communications regulator (MCMC) has been tasked with bringing Starlink and local mobile operators together.
•⁠  ⁠The initiative aims to reduce mobile dead zones across remote and underserved regions.

No special satellite phone required—just an ordinary smartphone, connecting directly to space.

BREAKING: Tesla has signed three 15-year solar power agreements with Concord New Energy in the United States. ☀️⚡

• Three solar projects totaling approximately 469 MW.
• Expected to generate around 1,200 GWh of electricity annually.
• The first project is expected to begin supplying power in the first half of 2027.
• More than 4 GW of additional U.S. projects are under development.

Although the agreements were secured in 2025, Tesla was officially identified as the customer for the first time today.
